scripts.title: Run script
scripts.confirm:
Run {name}?

A script can change anything in the data file and can read and write any file on this computer. The change cannot be undone; Revert to Saved is the way back. Only run scripts you trust.

This runs UndertaleModTool-style .csx scripts, but only part of that tool's functions exist here: Data, FilePath, ScriptPath, ScriptMessage, ScriptWarning, ScriptError and ScriptQuestion (answered yes). Scripts that need dialogs, the decompiler helpers or the UI stop with a compile error that names the missing function.

risky.includedRename:
{reason}

The game looks the file up by its name, so it may not find it after the rename. This cannot be undone.
risky.includedDelete:
{reason}

The game may fail where it loads this file. The file is moved to the Studio trash folder.
risky.audioSizeTitle: Put in a very large audio file anyway?
risky.audioSize:
{reason}

A very large sound uses a lot of memory when the data file is opened and saved, and the game can fail to load it. Undo takes it out again until you save.
risky.audioKindTitle: Put in audio of another kind anyway?
risky.audioKind:
{reason}

The sound keeps its old type and flags, so the game may not play audio of another kind. Undo brings the old audio back until you save.
risky.pageSizeTitle: Replace the page with a picture of another size?
risky.pageSize:
{reason}

Every sprite frame, glyph and tile on this page points at a rectangle on it. With another size they can show the wrong part or nothing. Undo brings the old picture back until you save.
risky.lastFrame:
{reason}

A sprite without frames draws nothing, and the game can fail where it uses {name}. Undo puts the frame back until you save.
risky.lastPoint:
{reason}

An empty path can make the game fail where it follows {name}. Undo puts the point back until you save.
risky.importType:
{reason}

If you go on, Studio reads the file as text and makes a script from it. A file that is not GML will not compile as it is. Undo removes the script until you save.
risky.copySizeTitle: Copy a very large package anyway?
risky.copySize:
{reason}

The whole package is held in memory and in the journal, so Studio can run out of memory or become slow. Undo removes the copy until you save.
risky.collisionTitle: Delete {name} and remove the events that aim at it?
risky.collision:
{reason}

If you go on, those collision events and their code are removed from the other objects. Undo brings them back until you save.
risky.roomPngTitle: Save a reduced picture of the room?
risky.roomPng:
{reason}

If you go on, the picture is made smaller so that its longer side is 16384 pixels. It is not pixel for pixel.
risky.unsavedBulk: You have unsaved changes. This action cannot be undone, so the undo history is cleared. The unsaved changes stay in the file in memory but can no longer be undone, and crash recovery starts again from here. Save first if you are unsure.
risky.unsavedExport: You have unsaved changes. The mod or patch is made from the saved file on disk, so they are not in it. Save first to include them.

live.trustTitle: Run options found next to this data file
live.trustBody: This data file has run options stored next to it. They can start any program on your PC. Program: {runner}. Arguments: {arguments}. Folder: {folder}. Environment: {environment}. Use them? If you decline, your Settings are used.
live.unknownExe: {path} is not a known game runner. It runs anyway; its output and exit code are shown here.
live.inPlaceWarning: The run saves your data file first (a backup is kept as usual) and starts the game on it.
live.crashed: {name} ended with exit code {code}. Last output: {lines}
live.noEntry: The code entry {entry} is not in this data file.
live.workingDir: Working folder (empty is the data file folder)
live.stopSeconds: Seconds to wait for the game to close before it is killed
live.saveInPlace: Save the data file and run on it instead of a working copy
live.autoRestart: Restart the running game after an edit
live.saveProject: Save these options for this data file
live.migrateAsk: Copy these run options into Studio's folder? They then need no approval. The file next to the data file stays and is no longer used.
live.migrated: Run options moved to Studio's folder.
live.nothingToMigrate: No run options file next to the data file.

prompts.dontAskClose: Don't ask again (keep changes in the journal when closing)
prompts.note: Prompts you silenced with "Don't ask again" are listed here. Choose Ask to see a prompt again. Security prompts for run files, plugins, packs and patches are always shown.
prompts.momentAsk: Copy the code too, so the new moment has code entries of its own, or share the code entries so an edit shows in both moments?

item.closeUnsaved: Ask when closing with unsaved changes
item.tempRunWarning: Notice that a run uses a temporary copy
item.riskyAction: Risky edits and actions (yes: go on, no: refuse)
item.unsavedChanges: Going on with unsaved changes (yes: go on, no: refuse)
item.copyToSave: Save the target file before copying to it
item.importResources: Import resources into the open file
item.debuggerFlag: Turn the GameMaker debugger flag on
item.migrateRunOptions: Move run options into Studio's folder
item.timelineCopyCode: Copying a timeline moment: always copy the code
item.timelineCopyShare: Copying a timeline moment: always share the code entries
item.copyKeepOrganize: Keep folders, collections and tags when copying to another file

modBase.clearFailed: The cache could not be cleared. Some files are in use.
modBase.changedTitle: The file changed since it was remembered
modBase.changedAsk: The file changed since it was remembered. Use the remembered original, or remember this file as the new base?
modBase.useThis: Remember this file as the new base
modBase.enabled: Keep a copy of each data file when it is first opened, as the base for Export Mod Pack
modBase.note: Export Mod Pack compares your file with the original. Studio keeps a compressed copy of the original so it does not have to ask. The oldest copies are dropped when the limit is reached.
modBase.tooBig: {name} is larger than the cache limit, so no copy was kept.
modBase.cleared: The mod base cache is empty.
modBase.lost: The saved copy of the original is missing or damaged. Choose the original file.
modBase.mismatch: That file does not match the saved original (the hash differs). Nothing was exported.
